title: Supply of Geyser, Refrigerator, Air Conditioner and Washing Machine at various Lighthouse under Kolkata Directorate
summary: GeM bid for supply, installation and testing of 3 geysers, 2 refrigerators, 3 split air conditioners and 4 washing machines at six lighthouse/DGPS/NAVTEX stations under the Kolkata Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhawan, D-372/2, Taratala Road, Kolkata

sites.name: Sagar Island LH & DGPS Station
sites.work: Supply of 1 geyser and 1 washing machine

sites.name: Paradip LH & DGPS Station
sites.work: Supply of 1 geyser, 1 washing machine, 1 refrigerator and 1 air conditioner

sites.name: Kalingapatnam LH
sites.work: Supply of 1 air conditioner and 1 washing machine

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee; MSME bidders seeking exemption to submit Bid Securing Declaration (Annexure-III). MII purchase preference L1+20% (50% qty); MSE purchase preference L1+15% (25% qty). Option clause +/-25% quantity.

period.warranty: 1 year from final acceptance (compressor 10 years for refrigerator; motor 10 years for washing machine per GeM spec)

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 2 lakh; OEM average turnover: Rs 24 lakh (MSE and startup relaxation: complete)
3 years past experience; past performance 30% of bid quantity

Technical evaluation by marks: average annual turnover (min 30% of estimated cost per year) 16 marks, solvency certificate (min 40% of estimated cost) 4 marks, experience 30 marks, time over-run 20 marks, quality 30 marks; minimum total 60
Similar works in last 7 years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost; ATC defines similar works as 'Supply and installation of batteries'

Mandatory: EMD or Bid Securing Declaration, PAN, GST, authorised dealership/distributor/OEM/reseller certificate for the appliances, non-blacklisting affidavit (2026), ITRs for 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26, unconditional price bid undertaking, bid acceptance letter, technical compliance sheet
Only Class-I and Class-II local suppliers (MII); minimum local content 50%/20%
specs: Geyser: closed water heater, 10 litre, BEE 4 star, wall mount, ISI marked to IS 2082
Refrigerator: double door; GeM spec frost-free 301-350 L, BEE 3 star or higher, IS 17550; ATC compliance sheet says 261-300 L, 3 shelves
Split AC: wall mount, 5 star, inverter, cooling only; GeM spec 1.3-1.7 ton (medium, 130-180 sq ft), ATC says 1.5-1.7 ton with ODU stand, drain pipe and cable; IS 1391 (Part 2)
Washing machine: fully automatic front load, 8 kg, water heating, toughened glass lid, stainless steel drum and cabinet, digital touch panel, Wi-Fi IoT
notes: Pages 1-13 GeM bid (text); pages 14-24 scanned ATC, evaluation criteria, compliance sheet, quantity sheet and annexures. Inconsistencies: ATC 'similar works' is 'Supply and installation of batteries' and EMD exemption mentions 'relevant category of battery' (apparently copied from another tender); refrigerator volume and AC capacity differ between GeM spec and ATC compliance sheet. GeM marked as short-duration bid for emergency procurement. Listing title says 'Procurement of...' while documents say 'Supply of...'. Station contact names and mobile numbers in delivery addresses not recorded.
